rubric_items.reason: All 8 acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-15, REQ-17, REQ-18; the 300-char limit and own-page changes are out of scope with reasons; the IDE answer becomes REQ-16.
Previous F-1 fixed: AC5 is now split into REQ-6 (status filter), REQ-17 (date range) and REQ-18 (paging). Every REQ holds one checkable behaviour.
Every known REQ cites a ticket line or the A-01 IDE answer; nothing invented, nothing assumed.
No clash between ticket and baseline; REQ-14 agrees with the data-protection rule and cites both.
The only question (Q-01) was answered in the IDE with real options; no needless open questions.
Readable, but previous F-2 remains: backtick marking of glossary terms is still inconsistent.

findings.text: Previous F-2 not fixed: No-show is backticked but Scheduled and Completed are not, and non-glossary phrases such as `own page`, `Opening` and `booking` are backticked as if they were defined terms.

cites.quote: The full reason is still shown on the appointment's `own page`.

findings.suggested_fix: Mark only glossary terms (Cancelled, Scheduled, Completed, No-show, Dashboard, Medical history) and mark them the same way everywhere; drop backticks from ordinary phrases.

findings.text: Ordering: REQ-17 and REQ-18, split out of acceptance criterion 5, are listed after REQ-16 rather than next to REQ-6, so the list no longer follows the ticket's order.

cites.quote: REQ-6, REQ-17, REQ-18: acceptance criterion 5, split per behaviour (status filter, date range, paging).

findings.suggested_fix: Renumber so the date-range and paging REQs follow REQ-6 directly, or list them next to REQ-6 in the body.

cites.quote: A cancelled appointment always has a reason of up to 300 characters
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason
Medical history appears only on the patient's own page, never in lists
